risks.name: Mutable metadata
risks.description: Token metadata can be changed by the owner

sources.snapshot_sql: SELECT h.*, COALESCE(ko.name, kt.name, lk.label) AS label, COALESCE(ko.type, kt.type, lk.label_type) AS label_type FROM casefile_snap.m_d54bf9a14eb4_holders_snap h LEFT JOIN (SELECT address, max(name) AS name, max(type) AS type FROM casefile_snap.m_d54bf9a14eb4_known_accounts_snap GROUP BY address) ko ON ko.address = h.owner LEFT JOIN (SELECT address, max(name) AS name, max(type) AS type FROM casefile_snap.m_d54bf9a14eb4_known_accounts_snap GROUP BY address) kt ON kt.address = h.token_account LEFT JOIN (SELECT token_account, "locker" AS label, max(type) AS label_type FROM casefile_snap.m_d54bf9a14eb4_lockers_snap GROUP BY token_account) lk ON lk.token_account = h.token_account
SELECT *, current_timestamp() AS captured_at FROM casefile.m_d54bf9a14eb4_insiders
SELECT *, current_timestamp() AS captured_at FROM casefile.m_d54bf9a14eb4_lockers
SELECT *, current_timestamp() AS captured_at FROM casefile.m_d54bf9a14eb4_markets
SELECT *, current_timestamp() AS captured_at FROM casefile.m_d54bf9a14eb4_pairs
SELECT *, current_timestamp() AS captured_at FROM casefile.m_d54bf9a14eb4_risks
SELECT *, current_timestamp() AS captured_at FROM casefile.m_d54bf9a14eb4_summary

worst_price_change_pct.formula: lowest price_change_h1/h6/24h across own pairs with >= 10% of the top pair's liquidity

top_pair_liquidity_usd.formula: liquidity_usd of the top own pair

top_pair_fdv_usd.formula: fdv of the top own pair

danger_risks.formula: names of risks with level danger

top10_pct_all.formula: sum holders.pct of the top 10 rows

top10_pct_excluding_pools_lockers.formula: top 10 holders.pct minus rows labelled AMM or LOCKER

top10_pct_excluding_pools_lockers_custod.formula: as above, also minus wallets H-MEM marks likely custodian

own_pair_count.formula: DexScreener pairs whose base token is this mint

note: rebuilt from the frozen snapshot after the run; same rows the agents read (runs before 2026-10-23 ~13:00 UTC saw null fields omitted)
